Per the task I am not inferring a build from copy or a repository, and I will not link an internal/staging build.

If a public build is about to launch, reply with the date and URL and I will wire the button to it instead. Nothing will be changed until a named person confirms here.

Exact edit list I will make once someone confirms 'no public build' (so you can approve or adjust in one reply) - all in src/app/(homepage)/download/page.tsx of Cybertron-HNG/zedu-fe:

REMOVE:
1. The dead control itself - the ArrowBtn at line 221 (rendered as <a href="#" ...> because Button.tsx line 68 falls back to '#' when no href is passed; every other call site passes href or linkToHome), plus its unused import.
2. The section promise copy at line 218-220: 'Stay focused with a full learning workspace on your computer'.
3. Desktop promises in metadata, which are also copy that promises a desktop app: title (line 13), description (line 15), the 'desktop learning app' keyword (line 24), openGraph title/description (lines 30/32), twitter title/description (lines 46/48) - each rewritten to say iOS/Android only, with the new strings listed in the delivery.

If instead a public build is about to launch, give me the date and URL and I will wire the control to it and verify it resolves to a real file (recorded with date) - no internal or unpublished build will be linked either way.
